description: Reverse search for company directors and officers in France (a people search by surname): list the French companies where a person of a given surname holds (or held) an office, with the company SIREN, name and the person's role, for due diligence and network mapping. Person data limited to surname, first names, role and birth year. Homonyms are not disambiguated; common names are capped. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): any unit under partial diffusion, legal person included, is left out before any count (nombre_resultats and listes_bornees.resultats lowered), never in ecartes; resultats[].statut_diffusion is always totale. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

nom.description: Director surname to search. Unsupported characters are stripped, not rejected.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: search_french_company_directors

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Search French company directors
